qutb-minar-begun-aibak.description: A tall red sandstone tower with carved horizontal bands rises on the left, wrapped in bamboo scaffolding with workers climbing it and carrying stone. A bearded rider in chainmail and a turban sits on a dark horse in the foreground, with armoured riders behind him. Smoke and a small fire show at the lower left, and a ruined arched gateway stands at the right under a dark, cloudy sky.

iltutmish-caliphal-investiture.description: A bearded man in a grey-and-gold robe and turban holds a rolled scroll with a red wax seal while draping a heavy black robe with gold embroidery over the shoulders of a bearded man in a conical helmet-crown. Courtiers in turbans bow on both sides, an armoured guard stands at right, torches burn on the walls and a brazier glows in a pillared, arched stone hall.

alauddin-khalji-seizes-delhi.description: An older bearded man in a gold-embroidered robe and white feathered turban leans down to embrace a kneeling man in a dark embroidered robe and gold crown on a muddy riverbank. A wooden boat with a carved bench sits beside them. Armed men with swords and spears stand behind the kneeling man, and a large gold ornate umbrella stands above. The sky is overcast, the water is dark behind them. No visible text or frame.

alauddin-khalji-takes-chittor.description: A painted scene of a massive fortress on a rocky hill, its walls and towers lit by orange fires and smoke. An elephant with a rider and a richly draped howdah climbs a zigzag stone road toward the gate, with soldiers on siege ladders and figures in dark clothing along the walls and slopes. The painting is edge to edge, with no text or frame.

firoz-shah-founds-firozabad.description: A seated figure under a gold parasol on a red-cushioned dais watches as dozens of labourers haul a tall, smooth, unmarked pillar upright with ropes up a brick ramp toward a massive stepped stone fortress with crenellated walls. A river with boats and a distant smoke plume fill the background, and a crowd of onlookers in turbans and long coats stands at the lower left. The painting runs edge to edge in an oil-painting style, with no text or frame visible.

timur-sacks-delhi-1398.description: A bearded man in lamellar armour and a steel helmet rides a black horse at the front, pointing forward, with mounted archers in mail behind him. Behind them is a broken red-brick gate in a walled city, with a domed building and a minaret, under heavy smoke and orange fire. Two war elephants with howdahs stand on the right, with more figures in the smoke. No visible text, frame or bodies.

bahlul-lodi-founds-lodi-dynasty.description: A seated man in a grey robe and turban sits on a wooden armchair in a vaulted stone hall lit by torches and a shaft of light from a high window. Turbaned men sit and stand around him on a red patterned rug, several holding curved swords or daggers. No visible text, frame or border.

sikandar-lodi-founds-agra.description: A bearded man in a quilted black coat with gold embroidery and a tall ornate turban stands on the prow of a wooden boat, pointing toward a riverbank. On the bank, workers with stakes and cords and a few tents are laid out on bare earth, and smoke rises under a stormy sky. Other boats sit on the grey river, and a banner flies at the left edge. No text is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.

sher-shah-defeats-humayun-kannauj.description: A painting of armored horsemen crossing a churned, flooded river at dusk. In the right foreground a rider in a plumed turban and mail armour on a grey, armoured horse, with a gold-trimmed saddle cloth, splashes into the water. Behind him, mail-clad riders with swords and lances charge down a muddy bank. Smoke and a small fire glow in the distance under a dark stormy sky. No text, frame or border is visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

humayuns-tomb-begun.description: A woman in a black and gold embroidered veil and dress stands at left, gesturing, with attendants holding torches beside her at night. Behind her, a red sandstone and white marble domed-arch mausoleum is under construction, with scaffolding, ladders, workers carrying bricks and blocks, and small fires burning on the upper walls. A brick dome is partly built at the top right. No visible text, border or frame.

battle-haldighati-mughals-mewar.description: An armoured horseman in mail with a plumed helmet on a rearing brown horse thrusts a long lance toward an armoured war elephant carrying a howdah with a helmeted commander. They fight in a narrow rocky pass with cliffs on both sides, among soldiers with swords and round shields and fallen figures in the dust. A tiny faint logo-like mark sits in the bottom right corner. No frame or border.

jahangir-accession-agra.description: A man in a feathered jewelled turban and pearl necklaces leans over an ornate red sandstone balcony at night, lit by torches, holding a chain of golden bells. A ragged, thin figure sits on the ground below reaching up to grab the chain, which runs down to a dark post by the water. Arched Mughal-style palace architecture with carved screens fills the background. No visible text or frame.

jahangir-marries-nur-jahan.description: A painted scene of a seated man in a silver embroidered robe and a turban with a white plume, wearing pearl necklaces, beside a seated woman in a red and gold veil with heavy jewellery, on a patterned rug in a dim palace room under an ornate canopy. Attendants on both sides hold silver trays and pour gold coins and pearls over the couple, with lamps lit in the background. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

peacock-throne-unveiled-shah-jahan.description: A seated man in white robes, turban and pearl necklace sits under a golden canopied throne crowned by two jewelled peacocks and a gem-studded tree, with a faint halo behind his head. Dark-robed figures stand with bowed heads in a dim palace hall lit by torches, and ornate arches frame the background.

shah-jahan-begins-red-fort.description: A large red sandstone fortress with crenellated walls, domed towers and a gateway, with scaffolding on its towers, beside a river on the left. In the foreground, elephants with chains drag red sandstone blocks while many workers carry bricks and dig in the dirt. A rider on a brown horse wearing an ornate gold robe and a white turban, with attendants holding gold parasols, looks on beside a man in green holding a plan. Stormy sky, painted in an oil style.

shah-jahan-begins-jama-masjid-delhi.description: A large crowd of workers climbs a broad flight of stone steps on a rocky, excavated slope, carrying blocks on their heads. Above them stands a big mosque in red and cream stone with a tall pointed-arch gateway, several onion domes, minarets and scaffolding. Smoke rises into a hazy sunset sky, and a red-walled fort with towers sits in the distance at left. The scene is an oil-painting style, with no visible text, frame or border.

aurangzeb-seizes-throne-agra.description: An old bearded man in white robes sits on a marble window ledge behind a carved lattice screen, looking out at a white domed building across water under a stormy sky. Inside a dim arched room, two armoured men with a torch stand at a wooden door, and a third armoured man in a turban and sash stands at the right. Painted in an oil style, with no visible text or frame.

badshahi-mosque-lahore-completed.description: A large red sandstone mosque with white marble domes and tall corner minarets stands behind a vast courtyard filled with kneeling worshippers in pale robes, under a dark blue dusk sky with a warm glow on the horizon. A central arched gateway is decorated with carved panels, and a few small figures move across the paved plaza.

aurangzeb-dies-deccan.description: An elderly bearded man in a white robe and pale turban sits on a wooden cot inside a tent, stitching a small dark cap by candlelight. A gold-hilted sword with a red scabbard and a steel breastplate lie on the carpet at his feet, and stacked books sit on a low table. Through the open tent flap, a night camp with campfires, tents and rocky hills is visible. The style is an oil-painting look, filling the frame edge to edge with no text.

shah-alam-ii-returns-delhi.description: A man in cream robes and a turban sits on a gilded throne-howdah atop a grey elephant with a red and gold cloth, passing under a massive red sandstone gateway with arched openings and domed pavilions. Armoured horsemen with long spears ride close on both sides of the elephant, and a crowd in turbans and dark robes stands around in a haze of dust. No text, frame or border is visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

bahadur-shah-zafar-accession.description: An elderly bearded man in an ornate jeweled turban and gold-embroidered robe sits on a marble platform, writing with a reed pen on a sheet of paper. Ink pot and loose papers lie beside him, and a few cushions and a red rug surround the platform. Behind him, several older men in turbans and robes stand or sit in a dim arched hall with carved stone pillars. Pigeons peck at grain on the cracked stone floor in the foreground. The style is a realistic oil painting, edge to edge, with no frame or border.

last-mughal-emperor-deposed.description: An elderly bearded man in a cream turban and long robe, with a red-and-gold sash, holds out a curved gilt-hilted sword toward a uniformed officer in a dark red tunic, peaked cap and cross-belts. They stand in a dusty courtyard before a red sandstone arched gateway with domes and white inlay. Turbaned horsemen on dark horses stand in the background and haze fills the air.
